text:
mira (Design): Quick design sync: trace header + minimap accessibility + export labels. Proto: https://figma.redwood/trace-compact-v1.

josh (Product): Main pain: CSV headers don't match UI copy and customers get parsing errors.

kai (Eng-runtime): We'll send export rows with machine keys (snake_case) and include display names for the modal.

ara (Accessibility): Minimap currently uses many SVG rects with no tab stops. Recommend single-focus hotspot + arrow key traversal and aria-live announcements: "Span 3 of 24: db.query, duration 12ms, correlation id 0x1a2b".

mira (Design): Visual: show focus halo only when keyboard navigation is active. Use a body class toggle for that.

kai (Eng-runtime): Agreed. For perf we won't create 200 buttons; precompute bounding boxes and move one focus element.

lee (Eng-SRE): Export must include correlation_id and span_id. Also add an "Open spans with this ID" quick action in the header for triage.

josh (Product): Persist last-used export format per workspace (CSV/JSON). Small win.

ara (Accessibility): Icon-only "copy id" needs aria-label and higher contrast (suggest #2f2f2f). Announce copy success via live region.

mira (Design): Copy changes: "Save trace snapshot (PNG)", "Export events (CSV)", "Export structured trace (JSON)". Export modal will show a tiny mapping table: UI label -> export key.

kai (Eng-runtime): I'll add {displayName, exportKey} per column and a persist flag for last format.

mira (Design): I'll post a short PR checklist: 1) single-focus minimap + arrow nav + aria-live, 2) export mapping modal + persisted format, 3) keyboard-only focus halo, 4) copy-id aria-label + contrast, 5) precomputed minimap layout. Tagging @ara and @lee for sign-off.
